_comment: Curated supplementary cards shown above the 'More' toggle in the Food Prices grid. Hand-collected from member/loyalty pricing — not derived from the pipeline. Update prices monthly if desired; grocery-price-updater.py reads this file and re-emits the stapleItems field on every run, so values here are never overwritten by CI. Keys must match STAPLE_ICONS in index.html so each card picks up its Lucide SVG.
